declarations.name: AuiTreemap

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (shown path, item count, total, three largest items).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for values in tile labels, tooltips, the data table, and the summary (percentages use a percent format).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Top-level nodes: { id (unique across the tree), label, value?: number | null, children?: TreemapNode[], color?: 1-8 }. Groups default to the sum of their children (a positive own value takes precedence). Zero, negative, and missing values are not plotted. At most 32 levels of nesting.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Id of the group to show (drill-down state); null shows the top level. An unknown id or a leaf falls back to the top level. Setting it through update() emits no event.

inputs.name: drillDown
inputs.description: Allow opening groups by click and Enter/Space and going up with Backspace and the breadcrumb. false: groups are plain tiles and no breadcrumb is shown (drillTo() still works).

inputs.name: rootLabel
inputs.description: Name of the top level in the breadcrumb and the "Showing ..." text (default: localized "All").

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Shared chart option; a treemap labels its tiles directly and never shows a legend, so it has no effect.

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table of the whole hierarchy (name path, value, share of parent): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (label, value, share).

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Texture fills on tiles (by position in the shown level) so neighbors never differ by color alone (always on in forced colors).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

inputs.name: tileLabels
inputs.description: Print the label (groups that open end with ">") and the value inside tiles that are large enough.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the layout (largest tile at the top right), right-aligns tile labels, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Shared chart option; a treemap has no series, so it has no effect.

outputs.name: drilled
outputs.description: The shown group changed through a tile (click, Enter/Space), Backspace, the breadcrumb, or drillTo(). id: the shown group (null: top level); path: ids from the top level. Not emitted for update({ root }).

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

properties.name: path
properties.description: Read-only: Ids from the top level to the shown group (empty at the top level).

methods.name: drillTo
methods.description: Show the group id (null: top level). Ignored for leaves, unknown ids, and the current group. Emits aui-drill and announces "Showing {path}" politely; when focus was in the chart it moves to the largest tile (going down) or the group you came from (going up).

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; a treemap has no series, so it only re-renders.

accessibility.pattern: SVG treemap as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "treemap") of role="img" tiles in size order with roving focus; one level shown at a time with drill-down (Enter/Space, click), Backspace and a breadcrumb (nav "Treemap path") to go up, a polite announcement of the shown level, and a data table of the whole hierarchy.

limitations: One level is drawn at a time (no nested rendering of grandchildren).
Zero, negative, and missing values are not plotted and are not listed in the table.
A group's own positive value replaces the sum of its children.
